facebook.caption:
4.8 stars. 1,080 reviews. For a Greek and Italian restaurant on a Vietnamese island.

MEDITERRAN delivers pizza, pasta, and souvlaki that hold up against anything back home. Sit on Đường Trần Hưng Đạo, order the souvlaki, and wonder why you didn't come here on night one.

Around $15-30 a head. Worth every cent.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
